woorden.We denken graag met u mee over uw warmte: We are glad to think along with you about your heat demand and the residual streams you have. No obligation.

woorden.Verwarmt meerdere gebouwen op het terrei: Heats several buildings on the site and saves € 22,000 in heating costs per year.
woorden.De mest van het bedrijf gaat, gemengd me: The farm manure, mixed with its own pruning waste, goes into the system each year. That covers 95% of the heat demand of the whole site.
woorden.De mest hoeft niet meer afgevoerd te wor: The manure no longer has to be taken away. Mixed with some pruning waste it goes into the system each year and delivers the heat for the buildings on the site. That covers 95% of the heat demand and saves roughly € 22,000 in heating costs per year.
woorden.Wat overblijft is 30 ton compost per jaa: What is left over is 30 tonnes of compost per year. It goes onto the farm land, where a plot is being restored over two years for a food forest. Compost counteracts soil subsidence and adds soil life and nutrients, so that this land becomes usable again.
